node.label: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease in female carriers
node.definition: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease (PMD) in female carriers is the presentation of PMD in some women carrying mutations in the PLP1 gene (Xq22).

mechanism_classes.label: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3)
